description: Tiered try-loop dispatcher model mapping (issue #1524). L0/L1/L2 -> concrete model ids, one per provider, with a default provider. The provider (claude vs deepseek) is a config choice so it can change without code edits. Tier definitions are canonically documented in vendor/CMR/docs/MODEL-PROFILES.md; this file maps those tiers to the concrete invocation model ids the dispatcher runs.
